limitations: This is plan approval, not implementation verification, semantic approval of future assertion bodies, migration approval, human acceptance or workstream completion.

Real browser dependencies/process teardown, bounded execution within 300 seconds, genuine retained authority and final candidate human answers must be established during their assigned tasks. Missing setup is an error/refusal, not behavior red or skipped green.

Approval relies on the explicit implementation design: RWB-102 exercises existing foundation entries; association is introduced/tested in RWB-103; migration and representative gates are introduced/tested in RWB-108; successful browser/human demonstration is RWB-109.
